# SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3

The browser mini build is generated from the pinned `xlsx` development dependency by `scripts/prepare-inventory-vendor.js` during installation and builds. Package integrity is locked in `package-lock.json`. The generated third-party bundle is not maintained as application source. It is served locally so exports do not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- License: Apache 2.0, included in LICENSE.
